page_title: Blurt by AssemblyAI – Voice to text, wherever you want it

summary.name: Blurt
summary.one_liner: Blurt is a free, open-source Mac dictation app from AssemblyAI that types what you say wherever your cursor is, using a hold-a-key push-to-talk workflow.
use_cases: multilingual dictation with mid-sentence language switching
building a custom dictation app on the AssemblyAI API
summary.what_it_does: Blurt lets you hold or tap a key (the right key by default), speak, and have the transcribed words inserted into whatever text field you are typing in. It cleans up rambling speech into written text and lets you define different writing styles, such as one for Slack and another for email, switchable from the main menu. The page says it supports 19 languages with mid-sentence code-switching. It is built on AssemblyAI's Dictation API, which the page also offers to developers for building their own apps, with a short Python example that returns verbatim, cleaned-up, and fallback text.
notable: Built on AssemblyAI's Dictation API, claimed up to 30% fewer hallucinations than Whisper
Customizable writing styles defined in prompts and switched from the main menu
caveats: Page does not say whether the cleanup and transcription depend on a paid AssemblyAI API key; the example code requires an API key
Page describes only macOS; other platforms are not named for the app itself
